topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found out today that my so-called partner has been filling pages with words, crafting a story that molds me into some character in a fictional world. It's not every day you discover you're the protagonist in someone else’s imagination, without your say. They probably thought it was sweet, a love letter disguised as a novel. What they didn’t consider was that every word, every fabricated scene, twists a bit of truth, distorts the real me. I’m not a character in their story; I have my own narrative, my own life. Yet here I am, bound by lines of ink and paper, objectified in their private little world.
